list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, Nov 2026
missable_warning: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and finish the meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway. Everything else can be earned in free-roam after the story, and there is no mission replay, so story trophies must be earned as you play.
note: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide and cites its sources by name; where no reliable method had been published yet (the game released 19 Nov 2026), the guide says so instead of inventing steps.

roadmap.text: Finish the five chapters at your own pace and take side content as it appears. Story trophies pop as you go, and everything you do already counts toward the 100% checklist, even though you cannot see it yet. Do the one thing that can be missed in this step: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see the missable warning). Turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings, and scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel.
roadmap.title: Play the story — 60 to 80 hours

roadmap.text: After the final mission you stay in free-roam and the checklist unlocks (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). Work through what is left: all robberies including the 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges. You do not need literally everything — that is what makes 100% reachable.
roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist — about 100 hours

roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger mission strands, then sweep up whatever trophies are left: stunts, races, WAiNK scans, meditations, vehicle discoveries and the spending and laundering totals. The platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 is earned.
roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup — 10 to 20 hours

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly — work through the roadmap and it follows. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum; Push Square puts the total higher, at 300 hours or more. One playthrough is enough and every trophy is offline single-player, with no online trophy in the list. Keep cheats off: GTABase reports that using a cheat disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this pops early in Chapter 1 just by playing. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1; it comes naturally. The one thing Chapter 1 asks of a trophy hunter is the missable meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — do that before the chapter ends (see its guide).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Character switching opens up after the Coffee Break mission in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx), which matters later for the meditation trophy, where meditating with both characters counts double.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Just keep playing the story; there is no mission replay, so story trophies are earned as you go, but they all pop on completion.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. The story has five chapters in total (PowerPyx), so one chapter remains after this one.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. Once it pops you stay in free-roam — Push Square notes you can keep exploring Leonida for as long as you like, and that is when the real cleanup begins. There is no mission replay (PowerPyx), so this is the point where the 100% checklist unlocks.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Breakfast Run mission. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist. Like the other mission trophies, finish the mission and it is yours.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Child's Play mission. It pops on completion, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Headliners mission. It pops on completion, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the VCIA Takedown mission at Vice City International Airport. It pops on completion, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Operation Savage Glory mission. It pops on completion, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per GTABase and EGamers. Reach 100% completion: the checklist unlocks after the story — PowerPyx puts it at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, Push Square at Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion. You do not need literally everything — for example only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count (Push Square). GTABase lists what the checklist needs in full: all robberies including the 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Progress made during the story already counts toward it (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Push Square counts 397 stunts in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so you need just over half of them. Stunt jumps have extra challenges attached that this trophy does not need. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find stunt spots at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (Push Square). Just sample one of everything — races, shooting ranges, fishing, drone races, arcade games and the rest — and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges exist: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges (Push Square). Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some are locked until you meet conditions shown on the map. The 42 gold medals are also part of the 100% checklist (GTABase).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee (Push Square). Find the locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count. Track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing (Push Square). Many race spots let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating, which mod shops can raise with upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early on Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2 kg; fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod — hijack one nearby if you have none (Push Square).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written — the game is a day old — so the honest route is: find an arcade machine while exploring, play one game through to its end, and the trophy should pop. Nothing in the published guides flags it as missable, and the game stays open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — finish all of Andy's story missions and this pops at the end of the strand (Push Square). Take side-character missions when they appear: PowerPyx notes many optional missions disappear after a while, though that does not affect trophies.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, named Maritime Disputes (Push Square). Work through Kenton's strand and the trophy pops when that mission ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission, named Hometown Heroes (Push Square). Work through Billy's strand and the trophy pops when that mission ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; work through eight full strands. No published guide yet lists all eight strands, so use the in-game map and Progress menu to see which are open, and take them as they appear — PowerPyx notes optional missions can disappear after a while, though that does not block trophies.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission — finish all of Randy's missions (Push Square). Randy's strand includes a vehicle wish list; Push Square links a list of those vehicle locations.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — finish all of Tyrone's missions (Push Square). The strand involves Kitty Litter Lab locations, which Push Square lists separately.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable. Meditate at every spot: 18 meditations across 10 spot locations; meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts as 2, and you can play as both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The final spot, Ascent Mountain, is marked only after the others are done (PowerPyx). The risk is in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, choose Accept, and finish the meditation. It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway — it is gone after Chapter 1. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played (Push Square). Track progress at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1 — do it before the chapter ends (see guide).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. No published guide yet gives the animal or the location — the game is a day old. The practical route: follow Bret's strand when it appears and take the hunt it offers. Nothing published flags it missable, and hunting stays available in free-roam after the story (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; 15 full sets are needed for 100% completion, so this pops on the way there (Push Square). Track them at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward progress.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is a phone app (hold Up to open the phone). Scannable things: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags (Push Square). Any 100 scans count, so scan as you travel. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this also comes on the road to A Long Road (Push Square). See them all at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: keep the same wanted level across three shop robberies in a row with your partner — plan an escape route first, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or scanning it with WAiNK, and it should come naturally through the story (Push Square). Track what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: find a busy fight, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five enemies before it ends — pick a spot with plenty of cover and clustered enemies. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The description points at leaving the airport by plane without following the normal route — try taking off from VCIA and leaving the area. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino tank. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written, so treat the description as the clue: get into trouble with Rhino tanks (the military response at high wanted levels) and survive the encounter. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the goods before anyone spots you or raises the alarm — quiet approach, no witnesses. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. There are 8 bank vault robberies in the game (KeenGamer, GTABase), so you need five of the eight; all eight are also required for 100% completion (GTABase). Plan each escape route before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written — armored trucks appear on the roads; hit one, take the cash, and lose the pursuit. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The tracked target is 52 areas (TrueAchievements / GTA Vice list data). GTABase's advice: clear the fog from the whole map, quickest by plane, flying over every dark patch. Exploration progress carries through the story and free-roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. The operations show as yellow map icons; Progress > Gangs keeps count (GTABase). The 100% checklist needs all 39 gang operations, so this pops early on that road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: find a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and the trophy should pop. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written. The shape of it, from the description alone: drive a car through the front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written — visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game through. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is vague, and no published guide yet explains the trigger. It reads like a partner moment rather than a grind. Honest status: unconfirmed; check back as guides fill in after launch. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The description — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — points at making choices in the game. No published guide yet gives a count or a method, so do not trust a number from an unconfirmed list; play normally, make choices when offered, and revisit this one once launch-week guides pin it down. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. No published guide yet confirms the trigger. Honest status: unconfirmed; treat it as a 'keep playing and it will come' trophy until a guide pins it down. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points at a strange scripted moment or easter egg. No published guide yet names it. Honest status: unconfirmed; it will likely be documented within launch week. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the name and description point at knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. No published guide yet confirms the exact trigger or count. Try a melee swing from a slow-moving vehicle near a group on foot. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. No detailed method had been published yet when this guide was written — marked bills come from robberies, and contacts launder them for clean cash. Work robberies (bank vaults, armored trucks, shops) and launder through your contacts until the $250,000 total is reached. It is not reported missable.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts and it adds up over a playthrough (Push Square). Find shops on the map at Touch Pad > Style.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — $160,000 in total (Push Square): Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up). Garages store vehicles registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros delivers a registered vehicle to you, repaired, for a small fee. Register a vehicle you are driving at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot — the fee depends on the vehicle's value (Push Square). Garages from Little Boxes add spots; you need 10 different vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
